items.text: Fixed Tool Cupboard (TC) notifications and map icons: TCs no longer get sent to players on the tutorial island, TC icons are correctly hidden on other map views (MLRS, vending, etc.), and the TC label on the map no longer shows a delete button after network updates.

Improved livestock breeding and feeding logic: removed adult/calves distinction, now considers unborn calves for breeding caps, and fixed cases where livestock couldn't breed or eat due to unreachable mates or troughs.

Fixed old animal AI issues: bears, stags, boars, and chickens no longer sleep (preventing dead‑look jumpscares), they now flee correctly when shot from a distance, and bears' roaming speed is corrected.
Restored livestock petting functionality and corrected petting rotation to use the proper agent.

Comprehensive cow system overhaul: simplified ownership, removed age death, added milk charge system, UI shows owner, milk cooldown, pregnancy info, trough food forecasts, changed grazing mechanics, allowed cows to eat horse food, added teleport‑food fallback, renamed naming logic, and separated frame budgets to prevent livestock from slowing down other server activities.
Fixed splash damage applying through walls on triangle floors/frames and corrected boomerang damage calculations.
Fixed vending UI bugs: 'Add sell order' now respects stack size limits, and hovering over items correctly displays the actual stack count instead of always showing 1x.
Resolved several PT turret issues: ammo now refills correctly after server restarts, reload animations work for all ammo types and stop playing after dismount, and toast notifications are preserved.
Boomerangs now deal proper damage to BaseNPC2 enemies.
Rockets no longer collide with ragdoll layers, preventing mid‑air explosions when fired near dead bodies.
Patrol Boat turrets can be reloaded again after the recent rewrite.
Fixed storage box bounds that previously caused the box to block placement against walls.
Animated building blocks are ignored when calculating headroom, eliminating unwanted auto‑crouch when near closing doors.
Added a cap to livestock breeding potential for animals without a mother (wild‑caught or vendor‑bought); only their offspring can be sold. Configurable via livestock.potentialUnbredCap.
Fixed map UI bug where the TC label could incorrectly show a delete button after a network update, and corrected sleeping bag button shuffling.

Overhauled cow system: permanent ownership, UI shows owner, cows no longer die of old age (only crowding), added milk buffering with up to 3 charges and UI cooldown, removed overgrazing mechanic, cows can eat any horse food, added teleport‑food fallback, UI now displays pregnancy details, trough UI shows projected food/water duration, cow names reflect owner language, and herd size limits prevent performance impact.
Fixed cows clipping through walls where heads would stick out of buildings.
Reapplied livestock petting and fixed rotation not using the agent.
Added a cap to animal potential for unbred animals; only offspring can be sold (configurable via livestock.potentialUnbredCap).
Stopped splash damage from passing through walls onto triangle floors and frames.
Extended triangle‑block visibility fix to cover frames and foundations.
Fixed boomerangs not dealing damage to BaseNPC2.
Prevented server projectiles from colliding with the ragdoll layer, stopping rockets from exploding near dead bodies.
Fixed PT turret ammo not refilling on restart, restored reload animations for all ammo types, and stopped animation after mid‑reload dismount.
Fixed PT boat turret reload issue after recent rewrite.
Fixed vending UI bug where adding a sell order could exceed stack size.
Fixed vending UI always showing a 1× multiplier when hovering over items.
Corrected storage box collision bounds that blocked movement against walls.
Headroom calculation now ignores animated building blocks, preventing unwanted auto‑crouch near closing doors.

items.text: A new 'potential' stat tracks an animal’s average happiness, influences vendor sale prices and prevents selling animals with zero potential; the value rises or falls over time based on current happiness.
Animals now dismount to the nearest valid spot with a physics check to avoid clipping through structures, and players receive toast notifications when mounting or dismounting fails due to obstacles.
PT Boat turrets now support full viewmodels, reload functionality, corrected rear turret aiming, and smoother rendering to eliminate stutter.
Mortar fire is now synchronized for all players, ensuring consistent behavior.
Weapon shot settings have been corrected, improving firing reliability.
Grenade throw velocity has been increased, allowing grenades to travel farther.
A biofuel generator pooling bug was fixed, restoring reliable fuel production.
Horse animations and behavior were fixed: horses now sleep correctly, dismounted horses no longer keep their heads turned, and animation pooling issues are resolved.
A crash triggered by ore flare devices has been resolved, improving overall game stability.
Tool cupboards no longer appear on the map when the max tool cupboard limit is disabled at runtime.
Viewmodel skins are restored and work correctly again.
The wounded first‑person sound now plays in builds (volume reduced by 50%).
Gun jitter is eliminated when turning animations are playing.
Harbor bridge and crane sounds no longer play on initial load.
RC computer screen blur issue fixed.
Spectator viewmodel drop animations now play correctly.
Added a sound effect when selling wool or animals, providing audible confirmation of the transaction.
Fixed a crash that occurred when copying and pasting invulnerable entities, allowing seamless duplication.

### Weapons & Combat

- Mortar fire is now synchronized for all players, ensuring consistent behavior.
- Weapon shot settings have been corrected, improving firing reliability.
- Grenade throw velocity has been increased, allowing grenades to travel farther.

### Power & Generators
- A biofuel generator pooling bug was fixed, restoring reliable fuel production.

### Mounts & Horses
- Horse animations and behavior were fixed: horses now sleep correctly, dismounted horses no longer keep their heads turned, and animation pooling issues are resolved.

### Stability & Crash Fixes
- A crash triggered by ore flare devices has been resolved, improving overall game stability.

### Bug Fixes
- Tool cupboards no longer appear on the map when the max tool cupboard limit is disabled at runtime.
- Viewmodel skins are restored and work correctly again.
- The wounded first‑person sound now plays in builds (volume reduced by 50%).
- Gun jitter is eliminated when turning animations are playing.
- Harbor bridge and crane sounds no longer play on initial load.
- RC computer screen blur issue fixed.
- Spectator viewmodel drop animations now play correctly.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Added a sound effect when selling wool or animals, providing audible confirmation of the transaction.
- Fixed a crash that occurred when copying and pasting invulnerable entities, allowing seamless duplication.

items.text: Map icons for Tool Cupboards added and deep‑sea marker issues fixed, improving map clarity and preventing marker loss.
Ferry terminal rope ladder climbing fixed, eliminating climb glitches and stuck rung animations.
Hit detection improved and boars now flee only below 30 % health, making combat more reliable and boar encounters less premature.
Livestock movement and feeding behavior refined, preventing cows from clipping and improving eating at troughs and grass.
New tea mixing‑table recipes and Wool Armor introduced, expanding crafting options and providing Tier 1 protection.
Crafting action moved to D‑pad down on all controller layouts for easier access.
BBQ and flame turret sounds corrected and one‑shot spawn noises (furnaces, campfires, mixing tables) silenced for a cleaner audio experience.
Fixed horses being able to fly, preventing unintended movement exploits.
Boombox mission events now only trigger for teammates on the same mission, avoiding irrelevant alerts.
Resolved client crashes caused by late-arriving network snapshots, improving stability during map transitions.
Tattoos now correctly persist between client and server, ensuring player cosmetics are saved.
Reloading maps now correctly includes level size data, preventing loading confusion when switching between maps.
Fixed several character customization bugs: UI fading issue, unwanted underwear prompt, and teleporting back to start when opening the menu.
Bee grenade prediction no longer shows a white grenade model, fixing visual glitch during throw prediction.
Fixed a NaN vertex lighting issue that could crash the game.
Helicopter flares now save correctly without corrupting job handlers, restoring flare functionality after saving.
Made helicopter flare saving thread‑safe, preventing crashes when multiple flares are saved simultaneously.
